phrases.text: Saturday night. Home game. Two thousand seats.
Six hundred season tickets. A hundred and eighty sponsor seats. Sixty VIP invitations.
And still, a third of the free seats stay empty.
Because nobody asked one simple question: are you coming?
Draw your hall once. Blocks, rows, seats. Copy, and done.
Season tickets and sponsor rights fill every home game, automatically.
A week before tip-off, the invitations go out, in every guest's own language.
No account. One tap. I'm coming, or I'm not.
Sponsors hand out their own seats to their own team.
No answer? A reminder. Then the deadline.
Every seat nobody claims comes back, and goes to the waitlist. First to accept gets it. Never twice.
At the door, a signed code, scanned in our app, even without signal.
Scanned twice? It turns red. Instantly.
After the game, every sponsor sees who really came.
One company took its seats from seventy-one to ninety-seven percent used, just by giving the empty ones back.
A full hall. Happy sponsors. No more spreadsheets.
